So last-match doesn't generalize. I'm reconsidering whether "Total Qty" is even the right line to anchor on, since it just happens to coincidentally give the right value rather than being semantically correct.

Since "Net Total" happens before rounding and "Net Total Rounded" is the final adjusted figure, taking the last match within that priority tier gives 19.00, the correct answer. Testing this priority-based extraction logic against receipt 0044 breaks it, since the first "Total" match it finds is actually a subtotal line ("Total (MYR): 17.93"), not the real total. I need to figure out which "Total" occurrences are false positives, like column headers or quantity totals that don't represent the actual amount.

I should just start implementing: OCR each image with preprocessing, then for each priority level scan lines, skip exclusion keywords, extract the last number from matching lines, and move to the next line if a keyword is found without a number.
